Inspired by the black cat, it embodies a design philosophy that blends cuteness and agility, serving as a distinctive mark in the high quality custom Kigurumi industry. BKC Is Owned By.. BlacKCat (BKC) is a brand under Molis, registered in Hong Kong as MOLIS CORPORATION(HONG KONG) LIMITED, a company committed to high-quality, innovative designs aimed at providing fetishists and crossdressers with prosthetic makeup services, silicone masks and related personalized lifestyles. You can check out Inthemask.com and MoliFX Studio - SFX Silicone Masks and Crossdressing Outfits by Moli's & MoliFX by Moli's for more crossdressing ideas. About BlacKCat(BKC) BKC, short for BlackCat, represents the spirit of 玄猫物语 (Black Cat’s Mystery). The brand was inspired by two beloved black cats owned by our founders, whose playful agility and charm continue to shape our design philosophy.

We are dedicated to setting new standards in the custom Kigurumi industry by combining creativity, precision, and craftsmanship. Every project is guided by one simple goal: to bring your character to life as faithfully as possible. From accessories to complex hairstyles, our team uses advanced 3D printing technology and meticulous hand-finishing techniques to capture every detail.

BKC also redefines the customer experience. Our streamlined system allows you to select options, place an order, and track your project’s progress at any time—making customization easier and more transparent than ever.
Behind the scenes, our support team is always ready to help. We’re here 24/7 to answer your questions and ensure your journey with BKC is seamless, from concept to delivery.
